title: Resolve a price mismatch on a grease invoice
instruction: Invoice VINV-103 from Northfield Lubricants is blocked. Establish the cause. Procurement has confirmed the purchase order price of $82.00 per drum is the agreed price and the vendor billed the wrong rate. Correct the invoice to the agreed price, re-match it, and approve it. Marcus Lindqvist (USR-006) handles the invoice; Sofia Duarte (USR-007) approves.
